repo.name: KytyPS5
repo.description: PlayStation 5 translation layer for Windows, Linux and macOS

commit.message: loader: log the first trap of each emulated guest instruction
shader: compile wave32 tessellation stages and give the TES its group vertex count
graphics: skip draws whose screen scissor is empty unless a vertex stage writes buffers
shader: accept SDWA byte sources for V_CVT_F16_I16
graphics: rebase texture views that lie entirely past MAX_MIP
graphics: accept mip-stats-enabled storage textures without counting their binds
